adaptation: DSH Themes Alpha module ID and profile metadata; legacy defineStore import now uses the official shared client-store module. Original feature implementation, source coordinate and license retained.

alphaPreferenceAdaptation.reason: The original 0ms/80ms one-shot restore can run before Alpha asynchronously adopts its durable built-in preference, resetting a saved custom palette on cold start.
alphaPreferenceAdaptation.change: Reassert a saved registered custom palette after a built-in theme/change adoption with a disposed timer and bounded retry count. Save an explicit user choice before changing preference so Default is respected.
alphaPreferenceAdaptation.verification: Forest live and cold-restart base color and saved pet settings must match.

viewportAdaptation: Keep a saved dragged pet within the current viewport when resizing. Clamp rendered position without overwriting the saved desktop position; start dragging from the actual visible rectangle and clean up the resize listener.
